name: AI/LLM application with governed model gateway
description: An application whose reasoning calls go exclusively through a ``ModelPort`` adapter, with per-call cost and latency logging, a deterministic guardrail that can reject a model's output independently of the model's own confidence, and drift monitoring. Grounded in module M7 ("AI/ML platform"), pattern P6 ("AI advisory, deterministic bounds") and P17's per-AI-call cost log.

parameters.name: model_provider
parameters.description: The model provider behind this pattern's ModelPort adapter.

parameters.name: task_type
parameters.description: The kind of model task this application performs.

parameters.name: guardrail_mode
parameters.description: Whether the deterministic guardrail blocks or only advises on a rejection.

parameters.name: max_tokens_per_call
parameters.description: Upper bound on tokens per model call, used to bound per-call cost.

preconditions: All model calls are routed through a ModelPort adapter; no direct SDK call to a model provider exists outside that adapter (spec 5.4 port catalogue).
A deterministic guardrail or evaluator exists that can reject an output independently of the model's own confidence score (P6).

outputs.description: ModelPort adapter for the selected provider (Vertex, Bedrock or Azure OpenAI).
Per-AI-call log of prompt hash, token counts, latency and micro-USD cost.
Statistical drift detection on model inputs/outputs over time.
Deterministic check that can reject a model output before it is used.

validation_rules.description: guardrail_mode=advisory is not permitted when task_type would mutate persisted state; only fail_closed may gate a write (architectural rule A5.7: controls fail closed).
max_tokens_per_call must be a positive integer.
model_provider=bedrock or azure_openai requires that provider's ModelPort contract tests have been run before first use; Vertex/ Gemini is this stack's default (spec 5.4 AI row).

evidence: CLOUD-ARCHITECTURE-PATTERNS.md 5.2 M7 ("MLOps, LLMOps gateway, model registry, drift, governance"; `mlops`, `mlops-aws`, `llmops`), P17 ("a per-AI-call log recording prompt hash, token counts, latency and integer-micro-USD cost") and 5.4's port catalogue row `ModelPort | adapters/model | Gemini, fake`.
